en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: 1) Forest pathology in the concept of stress ecology, biotic and non biotic stressors, Forest decline, complex diseases, tree dieback 2) Disease, pests and control in nurseries, 3) Root and but rots, pests of root system, Phytophthora root rot 4) Diseases and pests of cambium, cancers, insects, nematodes 5) Vascular diseases, ophiostomatoid fungi, relations of fungi with bark beetles, 6) Diseases and pests of conifers, significant saproxylic insects 7) Diseases and pests of broadleaved species, 8) Foliage and shoot diseases and pests of conifers, needlecasts 9) Foliage diseases and pests of broadleaved, significant defoliators 10) Diseases and pests in boreal forests 11) Diseases and pests in oak stands 12) Diseases and pests in pine stands and plantations 13) Diseases and pests in secondary spruce stands, spruce decline 14) Diseases and pests in beech stands and plantations 15) Diseases and pests in mountain forests 16) Diseases and pests in lowland forests and plantations 17) Diseases and pests in Mediterranean forests and plantations 18) Diseases and pests in coppices and coppices with standard 19) Diseases and pests on willows, poplars, elms, hornbeams, maples, alders, cherries etc. 20) Outbreaks of insects, gradology 21) Game damages, wildlife management 22) Phytosanitary regulations, EPPO, alien and invasive species, quarantine diseases and pests according of EU law
